headline: Yemeni government air strikes k!ll or injure 121 Houthis as UN warns of hunger
label: BREAKING
caption:
Fierce fighting and air strikes hit Yemen as a major new government offensive targets Houthi positions.

Yemeni military officials said that government forces and the Saudi led coalition carried out hundreds of attacks over a 24 hour period, leaving 121 Houthi fighters and commanders k!lled or wounded.

Strikes hit areas including the capital Sanaa, Taiz and Mocha, causing civilian casualties according to local reports and Al Jazeera coverage.

Meanwhile, UN agencies warned that about 1.8 million people face emergency levels of hunger in government held areas amid worsening violence and aid cuts.

How can international aid reach millions facing severe hunger in Yemen right now? 👇
